text:
2026-10-02 FROZEN budgets for the pointwise-inverse bridge, recorded before building it. User-directed steps 1-6.
Disclosure: P1-P3 correspond to quantities already observed in the 2026-10-02 assessment (direct solver call, not the production bridge). They are therefore not blind; they are re-checked through the production bridge. P4 and P6-JS have not been evaluated.
Policy: InversePolicy(tolerance 1e-8 mm, maxIterations 100, divergenceRatio 4) = reframe4s InversionSettings defaults; identity initialization; affine removed analytically (PointwiseInversion.displacementThenAffine).
P1 every one of the 64,984 fsLR vertices has status Converged with residual <= 1e-8 mm; zero non-converged.
P2 placement vs the all-vertex SimpleITK oracle: max <= 1e-6 mm per hemisphere.
P3 zero nearest-voxel disagreements vs the oracle on the 2009c res-01 (1 mm) and res-02 (2 mm) grids, all vertices.
P4 consumer fixtures (3 beta + 12 FIR maps, specs outside the repo) via the production route (FslrBridgeDisagreement): zero coverage, value and sign disagreements vs the oracle-placed same-frame route, every map and hemisphere.
P5 locked GM route: medial wall vertex-exact, zero BridgeUnavailable, inflated/veryinflated display identity, every inverse receipt Converged.
P6 cost: JVM admission + placement of both hemispheres <= 30 s; real-field Scala.js placement of both hemispheres measured and <= 120 s (Node, fastopt).
